EWA Volume Splatting
1 Introduction Volume rendering is an important technique in visualizing acquired and simulated data sets in scientific and engineering applications. The ideal volume rendering algorithm reconstructs a continuous function in 3D, transforms this 3D function into screen space, and then evaluates opacity integrals along line-of-sights.
